_meta.purpose: MEASURED validation targets, kept SEPARATE from param_db.json so the emergence engine never reads them. Used ONLY by the post-hoc falsifiable test (validate_organs) to GRADE predictions -- never to choose a parameter. The allometric exponents the engine uses (param_db.allometry) come from comparative MAMMALIAN physiology and were fixed independently of these HUMAN fractions, so testing one against the other is a genuine prediction-test, not a back-fit.
_meta.discipline: If emergence_organs.py ever reads this file, the gate's non-fit check FAILS by design.

organ_mass_g._provenance: ICRP Publication 89 (2002) reference adult male (~73 kg) and reference newborn (~3.5 kg) organ masses; standard pediatric anatomy. Order-of-magnitude reference values; read-only.

developmental_anchor._provenance: Well-established human developmental fact: the brain is ~10-12% of body mass at birth but ~2% in the adult (strong negative allometry); heart and lungs stay near a constant body-fraction (near-isometric).
